hints.content:
The number lines show that the ratio of $\maroonD{\text{meters}}$ to $\blueE{\text{percentage}}$ is $\maroonD{700}:\blueE{100\%}$.

We are looking for ratios that are equivalent to $\maroonD{700}:\blueE{100\%}$.

$\maroonD{700}\div \maroonD{175}= \purpleE{4}$

So, we can find the percentage for $\maroonD{175\,\text{m}}$ by dividing both parts of the ratio by $\purpleE{4}$.

[[☃ image 1]]

So $\blueE{25\%}$ of $700$ is $\maroonD{175}$.

options.alt: A double number line with 3 unequally spaced tick marks. The line labeled Distance, meters, reads from left to right: 0, 175, 700. The line labeled Percentage, reads from left to right: 0 percent, 25 percent, 100 percent. An arrow from the pair 700 to 100 percent to the pair 175 to 25 percent is labeled divided by 4.

hints.content:
$\maroonD{350}\div\maroonD{175}=\purpleE{2}$

Now we can find the percentage for $\maroonD{350\,\text{m}}$ by multiplying both parts of the new ratio by $\purpleE{2}$.

[[☃ image 1]]

So $\blueE{50\%}$ of $700$ is $\maroonD{350}$.

options.alt: A double number line with 4 unequally spaced tick marks. The line labeled Distance, meters, reads from left to right: 0, 175, 350, 700. The line labeled Percentage, reads from left to right: 0 percent, 25 percent, 50 percent, 100 percent. An arrow from the pair 175 to 25 percent to the pair 350 to 50 percent is labeled times 2.
